subtitle: Write your integer linear programming problem below or load it from a file.

tree.title: Search tree
tree.empty: Run the problem to see the tree.
tree.hint: Click a node to see its details. Drag to pan and scroll to zoom.

node.title: Node {{id}}
node.none: Click a node to see its information.

explain.title: Node analysis
explain.root: We solve the linear relaxation: the same problem ignoring the requirement of integer values. Its value is a bound for any integer solution.
explain.child: We solve the linear relaxation with the added constraint: {{bound}}.
explain.infeasible: The relaxation is infeasible: no point satisfies all constraints. The node is pruned by infeasibility.
explain.integer: All variables came out integer: this node is a candidate solution.
explain.newBest: It improves the best known solution (incumbent): $z = {{z}}$.
explain.notBest: But it does not improve the current incumbent.
explain.pruned: The relaxation ($z = {{z}}$) is no better than the incumbent ($z = {{inc}}$): no child can beat it. The node is pruned by bound.
explain.branched: The solution is fractional. Candidates and distance to 0.5: {{list}}. We branch on the variable $x_{ {{i}} } = {{value}}$ (the most fractional), creating two children: $x_{ {{i}} } \le {{floor}}$ and $x_{ {{i}} } \ge {{ceil}}$.
explain.branchedManual: The solution is fractional. Candidates and distance to 0.5: {{list}}. You chose to branch on $x_{ {{i}} } = {{value}}$, creating two children: $x_{ {{i}} } \le {{floor}}$ and $x_{ {{i}} } \ge {{ceil}}$.
explain.chooseVar: Branch on another variable (not expanded yet):

summary.title: Result
summary.optimal: Optimal integer solution found at node {{node}}.
summary.infeasible: The integer problem is infeasible: no integer point satisfies the constraints.
summary.unbounded: The problem is unbounded: the linear relaxation grows without limit.
summary.limit: The search stopped at the limit of {{max}} nodes; the best solution found may not be optimal.
summary.running: Search in progress… best solution so far: {{z}}.
